One file with button positions, sizes, visibility and opacity; controller mappings and shortcuts; global and per-game graphics, audio and shader settings; HUD, language, theme and automatic performance profiles.

Save the file in Downloads or on the SD card before uninstalling. Games, game saves and installed GPU drivers are backed up separately. After reinstalling, select your game folders again. Automatic performance profiles are used only if the device and driver configuration still match.
